A list of options that Remotion supports.

CLI flags override [configuration file defaults](/docs/config).

Only the CLI reads the config file. In programmatic APIs, you need to pass all options explicitly.

- [@remotion/media cache size](/docs/options/media-cache-size-in-bytes) (`--media-cache-size-in-bytes`)
